'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: High. THE SUPPLY AND DEBT CAPS ARE A DENIAL SURFACE. `deposit` checks `(<= (+ current-assets amount) CAP-SUPPLY)` against the `assets` var and `system-borrow` checks `(<= (+ debt amount) CAP-DEBT)` against `total-debt`, which grows with accrued interest alone. Show one principal occupying a cap so that no other user can deposit, or accrued interest alone tripping `CAP-DEBT` so that no borrower can refinance and no liquidator can act. Impact: temporary freezing of funds.'
